note: Sources whose terms permit programmatic collection. Empty by default: a source is added only after its authorization basis is recorded, and JobCards from an unlisted source never enter a market profile. Query templates describe search intent and are not an authorization to scrape any site.

sources.name: JobCards the user reviewed in this workspace
sources.notes: Postings the user opened and had structured into a reviewed JobCard through the normal application flow. This is the user's own working data, not a collection feed, so volume is limited to what they actually looked at.
